newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht, interbank rate ease in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht, interbank rate ease in late trade.

text.p: The Thai baht was slightly lower against the dollar in late trade on Tuesday on afternoon short-covering of the U.S. unit, dealers said.

"There was some bidding for the dollar in the late afternoon after heavy dollar selling in the morning. Some players were covering their (dollar) short positions as liquidity started to improve," one dealer at European bank said.
The baht was quoted at 26.085/26.089 to the dollar in late trade against 26.082/26.085 earlier.
All commercial banks have to meet the Bank of Thailand's reserve requirement on the seventh and 22nd of each month.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was traded at 5.75/6.25 satangs per dollar late compared with 6.50/7.00 in the morning.
